3-in-1 Air Duster, Vacuum Cleaner & Bag Vacuum This 3-in-1 versatile tool integrates air blowing, Vacuum Cleaner, and storage bag vacuum sealing into one compact design. It works as an efficient air duster to blast dust, hair, and debris from hard-to-reach gaps, doubles as a handheld vacuum to pick up loose particles for a thorough clean, and also vacuums air out of storage bags to save space and keep your items organized. One device replaces separate blower, vacuum, and bag vacuum tools, simplifying your daily cleaning and storage tasks.

Multi-Scene Cleaning It comes with a full set of practical accessories, including 2 cleaning brushes, 4 different air nozzles, 2 brush heads, and 1 replacement filter screen. Portable and durable Measuring only 136*92*39mm and weighing just 279g, this cordless electric air duster is ultra-compact and lightweight for easy carrying and storage.
